_readme: Flicker budgets (0050): pops ‰ per scenario/region from scripts/flicker.mjs, per label (engine[-gl] screen). node scripts/flicker-budget.mjs run.json fails when any budgeted region rises more than tolerance (25 %) or floor ‰ over its budget. Lower a budget with --write after a change that measurably cut flicker; never raise one to make a rise pass. The 'chromium desktop' / 'chromium phone' labels (Metal ANGLE on a Mac GPU) hold the lockdown sweep's baseline from 0050 (bbcb526) for the regions it measured; the 'chromium-swiftshader' labels are main measured on software GL (no GPU needed, so any sandbox can run the gate).
